title: Earned voice coach — API cost cap record
description: The receipt that a HARD SPENDING CAP exists on the API account. Owner ruling: a hard cap before the first real conversation. No verified record of this shape = no live session; there is no override. It is a receipt, never a place to put a key: any credential-shaped string in it fails verification (tools.verifyCostCap).

account_label.description: A human label for the account. NOT an account id, NOT a key, NOT an email.

cap_usd_month.description: The hard monthly cap actually set on the account.

cap_usd_session.description: The per-session ceiling the adapter enforces. Must be <= cap_usd_month.

per_minute_usd.description: Published voice-layer price at the time of verification ($0.05/min at GPT-Live-1 launch). Used to price a session budget, never to authorise one.

verified.description: Exactly true. A cap nobody checked is not a cap.

verified_at.description: ISO timestamp of the human check on the provider's own billing page. Re-verify within maxAgeDays (default 30).

verified_by.description: Who looked. The owner, by name.

evidence.description: What was seen, in words. Not a hash, not a token: a bare 40+ hex string fails the credential-shape scan.

_note.description: Present only on the shape example; a live record carries none.
